message: `aria-atomic="false"` on the part sets the live region of `error` otherwise than its role does
$reason: An error part with its `alert` and `aria-atomic="false"`, holding the field's name and the message in two nodes. Chromium 153 takes the atomicity the role implies away (measured on 2026-10-27); a reader then says the node that changed rather than the region (Orca reads the inserted text unless `container-atomic` is `true`, NVDA the new text), and Chromium takes a node's text as changed whole (`ComputeHypertextRemovedAndInserted`): a new message is said without the name before it. A part holding one text node, as every part of the library does, would be said whole either way. Point 7 read the part's role and politeness and what may hide it, and passed it.
